priority_scale.0: No useful numeric effect established or not an FPS/memory tuning lever; not zero cost.
priority_scale.2: Moderate candidate when this workload is relevant.
priority_scale.3: Leading candidate when this goal and workload are relevant.

forecast_policy.interval_kind: heuristic planning envelope, not a statistical confidence interval
forecast_policy.unmeasured_numeric_level_policy: No equal spacing from menu rank; optional explicit log interpolation only between measured numeric neighbors, bounded by their full endpoint effects.
forecast_policy.resource_margin_rule: Expand eligible paired-delta min/max by at least this margin, or the largest same-profile repeat difference if greater; first-raid memory transfer must additionally include zero until locally calibrated. These uncertainty margins are not a reserve for later raids; assess session stability separately.
forecast_policy.unknown_effect_policy: null/unknown; never silently substitute zero. Zero-effect FPS hypotheses for noise rows still need uncertainty.
forecast_policy.multi_change_policy: One row per setting/context; texture quality and Streets mode form one joint group. Use log-ratio combination, widen for shared bottlenecks; preserve unsupported components as unknown.
forecast_policy.noise_transfer_policy: A zero-effect FPS hypothesis is only for a comparable non-saturated workload. SSR/Volumetric noise results do not bound their FPS cost after GPU saturation or a new lighting/reflection workload; transferred cost remains unknown. Normal captures require no dedicated warmup; qualify preparation/weather differences without inventing cold-to-warm or rain/fog correction factors.
